create_BatchNorm1d: create a BatchNorm1d layer with learnable affine parameters for 2D or 3D input tensors
create_BatchNorm2d: create a BatchNorm2d spatial normalization layer for 4D input tensors with learnable parameters
create_BatchNorm3d: create a BatchNorm3d volumetric normalization layer for 5D input tensors with learnable parameters
create_SyncBatchNorm: create a SyncBatchNorm layer for distributed training that synchronizes statistics across GPUs
create_LazyBatchNorm1d: create a lazy BatchNorm1d layer that infers num_features from the first forward pass input
